title: Sunday · the ridge from the estuary
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The ridge from the estuary's mouth in April, the glow larger than 2009's, the trees drawn one by one. Two months before CEDAR is announced.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the ridge from the estuary mouth, the trees drawn individually in razor line under the wash, and above them the glow — larger than 'Lanes' had it, unmistakably warm.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, a forested ridge seen across an estuary mouth with each tree drawn individually in sharp ink beneath the wash and a warm unmistakable glow above the treeline, no words
image.notes: The glow: larger than 2009. Compare dw_2009-03-08.

panels.name: Ridge

panels.composition: Tier 2: the trees, close, cedar and fir, the line at its most exact. One dead snag among them.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, a dense stand of cedar and fir drawn in exact sharp ink with one dead gray snag among them, no words

panels.name: Trees

panels.composition: Tier 3: the estuary's water with the ridge and the glow reflected in it, upside down, the reflection warmer than the sky. Held.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rusted tin, still estuary water reflecting a forested ridge and a warm glow upside down, the reflection warmer than the actual sky, no words

panels.name: Water

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: The glow larger. The reflection warmer than the sky.
